verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships only through each harness's own plugin install mechanism and its porting guide says it never edits the user's files, which implies removal through the harness would not leave instructions behind in user files. It also offers a skills-search tool for discovering available skills. However, no evidence documents a list-installed command or an uninstall/removal flow, and on some harnesses (Codex, OpenCode) install works by having the agent follow a fetched INSTALL.md, so clean removal there is unclear. Missing for 10: documented way to list installed skills, documented uninstall/remove command, evidence that removal leaves no orphaned files or bootstrap/session-start instructions, hands-on confirmation of clean removal across harnesses.
